title: Adaptive-runtime experiment-control foundation
purpose: Define the planning-time architecture, schemas, canonical catalogs, compatibility boundary, fixtures, and deterministic validation needed before an adaptive-runtime experiment plan compiler may be implemented.
scope: This checkpoint governs experiment-control documents only. It does not compile plans, generate execution manifests, change runtime instrumentation or operation correlation, materialize effective behavior, project analytical data, execute performance measurement, authorize active_internal, or activate production behavior.
context: The runtime already has independently forceable lower-only seams for application-send batch formation and buffer-copy coalescing, while the configured application-send turn values remain behavior-equivalent. Existing adaptive-runtime-policy-catalog-v1 evidence is retained historical measurement metadata and is not rewritten by this contract suite.

requirements.title: Separate experiment planning, runtime eligibility, applied values, and effective behavior
requirements.statement: The experiment-control architecture MUST distinguish policy seam, configured value, forced value, shadow recommendation, candidate_value, plan eligibility, operation eligibility and reason, applied value, axis-specific mechanism event, deterministically derived effective behavior, experimental factor, context variable, and treatment eligibility; preserve the ordered configured-to-effective semantic sequence; permit one applied value to produce multiple bounded effective behaviors in one epoch; define the closed actuation_validation, isolated_counterfactual, interaction_screen, feedback_loop, and profile_validation experiment types; assign one canonical owner to every experiment-control fact; separate the source plan from the post-build compiled execution manifest; prohibit deriving effective behavior from performance measurements; and keep measurement, active_internal, and production authorization false.
notes: Plan eligibility is a planning fact; operation eligibility and the applied mechanism event remain runtime evidence facts.
The current one-behavior-distinct-axis runtime capability may block compiled interaction cells without making the source interaction plan structurally invalid.

requirements.title: Define strict versioned experiment-control schemas and canonical hashing
requirements.statement: The repository MUST provide strict self-contained v1 JSON Schemas for policy-axis contracts, effective-behavior catalogs, policy relationship graphs, combination-constraint catalogs, experiment-family catalogs, source experiment plans, plan-validation results, and compiled execution manifests; reject unknown fields; close status, experiment-type, relationship, validation, error, and warning vocabularies; carry stable versioned trace and content references; keep blocked and preparation-only axes non-executable; keep active behavior and performance acceptance unauthorized; resolve references deterministically; represent expected effective-cell equivalence and operation-scoped or bounded aggregate behavior; and reproduce lowercase SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON after excluding the document's own content_sha256 field.
notes: The schemas remain self-contained because PowerShell Test-Json has not resolved external local schema references reliably in retained adaptive-runtime evidence validation.
Array ordering is preserved only where order is semantic; set-like arrays use a documented deterministic sort.

requirements.title: Publish minimal canonical send-composition contracts while preserving catalog v1 evidence
requirements.statement: The experiment-control foundation MUST publish canonical v1 instances for application_send_batch_formation, buffer_copy_coalescing, and the behavior-equivalent application_send_turn_planning values; define deterministic effective-behavior identities and the directed batch-formation-to-buffer-coalescing relationship; define only the constraints and send_composition family needed for the first vertical slice; reference safety predicates and guardrails by stable ID and version; classify send-turn label comparisons as verification-only until a behavior-distinct planner exists; retain schemas/adaptive-runtime-policy-catalog-v1.schema.json, New-AdaptiveRuntimePolicyCatalog.ps1, existing fixtures, and historical evidence unchanged; and supersede that catalog only for new experiment-control planning while treating its generator as a historical compatibility producer.
notes: The new contract suite does not invalidate, migrate, normalize, or relabel retained v1 catalog evidence.
No new generator or compiler is part of this checkpoint.

requirements.title: Validate experiment-control fixtures and references deterministically
requirements.statement: The repository MUST retain schema-valid examples for every first-slice axis contract, catalog and graph, the actuation, isolated-counterfactual, and interaction-screen plans, a plan-validation result, and a compiled-manifest shape; retain invalid examples for every requested structural and semantic failure; validate every schema and valid fixture; reject every invalid fixture with stable sorted error codes; reject unknown fields, duplicate definitions and edges, illegal or unsupported values, unknown or stale references, executable blocked or preparation-only axes, forbidden authorization, malformed hashes, missing predicate references, and fixed/varied overlap; and prove repeated canonical serialization and hashing are byte-for-byte identical.
notes: The focused validator is schema and reference validation only; it is not the reserved generic plan compiler.
No fixture is campaign evidence or authorization to execute measurement.

requirements.title: Validate experiment plans through deterministic layered eligibility
requirements.statement: The repository MUST load source plans and the reviewed experiment-control catalogs without mutating either; validate schema, versions, references, architecture readiness, experiment-type rules, family membership, cross-axis constraints, capability expectations, retention, and authorization in a deterministic order; distinguish plan eligibility from runtime operation eligibility; require implemented, forceable, rollback-capable, actuation-proven behavior-distinct axes where the experiment type requires them; keep blocked and preparation-only axes non-executable; reject prohibited runtime-controller inputs; and emit only closed versioned error and warning codes.
notes: A structurally legal interaction may remain capability-pending.
No invalid plan is silently coerced into executable work.

requirements.title: Expand configured cells and expected behavior equivalence deterministically
requirements.statement: The plan compiler MUST deterministically report configured, expected-effective, and potential-execution cell counts; classify executable, structurally inactive, capability-pending, rejected, deduplicated, verification-retained, and behavior-distinctness-unknown cells; derive expected behavior classes from the effective-behavior catalog; preserve semantically meaningful treatment order while normalizing set-like arrays; collapse application_send_turn_planning legacy_current and conservative into one expected legacy_priority_stable_sequence behavior; classify that comparison verification_only; deduplicate expected-equivalent performance-oriented cells unless explicitly retained for verification; and compute canonical plan and validation SHA-256 values with the root self-hash excluded.
notes: Expected behavior is a planning classification and is not materialized from live runtime evidence here.
Performance measurements never determine an effective behavior identity.

requirements.title: Compile post-build dry-run execution manifests
requirements.statement: After successful plan validation, exact committed-source resolution, a focused build, binary and runner hashing, host fingerprinting, and capability resolution, the repository MUST be able to emit a dry-run compiled execution manifest that links the exact plan and validation hashes; records source commit, binary and runner identities, physical-host and virtual-machine identity when available, resolved capabilities, executable, capability-ineligible, and excluded cells, deterministic or seeded randomized execution order, output roots, retention rules, and expected result schemas; leaves the source plan immutable; rejects stale or interchangeable plan, validation, and manifest hashes; and keeps measurement and active behavior authorization false.
notes: Manifest generation is dry-run infrastructure only and cannot launch a campaign.
Host resolution never mutates the source plan.

requirements.title: Prove compiler classifications, hashes, and safety boundaries
requirements.statement: The repository MUST retain focused valid, warning, verification-only, capability-pending, structurally inactive, blocked, preparation-only, invalid-plan, invalid-validation, and invalid-manifest fixtures; require every valid plan to compile byte-identically on repeated runs; require each invalid fixture to emit its expected closed error; prove experiment-type axis counts, family bounds, fixed-axis legacy values, cross-axis legality, feedback history, transparent profiles, equivalence collapse, warning classification, self-hash exclusion, unordered-array normalization, meaningful-order preservation, meaningful-content hash changes, and plan-validation-manifest hash role separation; produce and validate one real post-build dry-run manifest; and run no performance, campaign, transform, CI, activation, or push action.
notes: The focused fixture harness is not a benchmark or campaign runner.
Runtime evidence and operation correlation remain reserved for the next checkpoint.

requirements.title: Correlate two-axis candidates, eligibility, operations, and mechanisms
requirements.statement: For application_send_batch_formation and buffer_copy_coalescing only, the runtime MUST preserve configured, forced, shadow-recommended, candidate, operation-eligibility, applied, and mechanism-event semantics as distinct fixed-field evidence; treat candidate_value as pre-safety; assign bounded connection-local epoch, decision-instance, and operation identities; preserve the batch plan join into a combined-buffer operation and the buffer operation join into exactly one terminal release; record legal and applied counts and bytes; retain inactive, clamped, fallback, invalid, negative, and unclassifiable outcomes; make broad endpoint observations ineligible as axis mechanism evidence; keep every lifecycle, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow-control, queue, ownership, cancellation, disposal, and terminal guard authoritative under forcing; keep shadow recommendations behavior-neutral; and add no hot-path dictionaries, boxing, unbounded retention, service location, runtime model loading, online learning, production activation, or performance authorization.
notes: Decision-instance and operation identities may share the same monotonic value when one seam decision owns exactly one operation, but they remain separate evidence fields.
This requirement does not release the send-composition interaction capability or authorize simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing.

requirements.title: Materialize effective behavior and recompute bounded aggregates
requirements.statement: The experiment-control evidence tooling MUST resolve the reviewed effective-behavior catalog by document identity, version, and content hash; derive effective_behavior_id only from axis-specific candidate, eligibility, applied-value, and mechanism-event evidence; reject ambiguous, conflicting, stale, wrong-axis, broad-endpoint, missing-correlation, duplicate-correlation, unsupported-behavior, and unclassifiable-assignment inputs with closed deterministic errors; allow multiple behavior IDs in one epoch when different operations prove different mechanisms; prohibit mutually exclusive behavior IDs on one operation; preserve source evidence references; and deterministically recompute bounded per-epoch operation, byte, fallback, error, inactive, and unclassifiable aggregates exactly from retained source rows.
notes: Effective behavior is never inferred from throughput, latency, CPU, allocations, or another performance result.
Materialization is deterministic, idempotent, correctness-only infrastructure.

requirements.title: Rebuild the two-axis analytical projection from immutable evidence
requirements.statement: The repository MUST provide a deterministic logical projection rebuilt from immutable plan, validation, compiled-manifest, checksummed raw-operation, release, materialized-behavior, result, and artifact inventory fixtures; uniquely identify connection epochs by run, connection key, and epoch sequence; uniquely identify axis decision summaries by epoch and axis; uniquely identify behavior aggregates by epoch, axis, catalog version, and behavior ID; deterministically join operations to decisions, epochs, results, releases, and checksums; retain invalid, failed, negative, inactive, clamped, fallback, excluded, and diagnostic classifications append-only; reject missing checksums, duplicate epoch identities, wrong epochs, invalid result joins, missing retained classifications, and release mismatches; and keep the projection rebuildable without making a mutable database the evidence authority.
notes: The logical projection does not select a long-term database technology.
No new performance dataset is generated to populate the projection.

requirements.title: Prove and stop the first runtime evidence vertical slice
requirements.statement: The repository MUST retain focused positive, inactive, clamped, fallback, interaction, multiple-behavior, aggregate, projection, invalid-attribution, release, checksum, and retained-negative fixtures for the two-axis slice; require valid materialization and projection output to be byte-identical and hash-identical on repeated runs; require every invalid fixture to emit its expected closed error; run focused seam, ownership, aggregate, validator, schema, compiler-regression, and SpecTrace checks; produce a review package covering architecture, ownership, experiment types, plan-versus-operation eligibility, hashing, both mechanisms, correlation, derivation, aggregation, fixtures, projection, trace, commits, remaining axes, blockers, Stage 5, and next action; and stop without performance measurement, campaigns, transforms, threshold tuning, model training, analytical projection from live performance data, CI changes, push, active_internal, production activation, or migration of another axis.
notes: Measurement remains frozen after this checkpoint.
The next action requires a separate reviewed prompt.

requirements.title: Make effective-behavior derivation catalog-authoritative
requirements.statement: The experiment-control hardening layer MUST derive operation effective behavior from the exact versioned effective-behavior catalog rather than a second code-owned mapping; match axis, exact mechanism-event identity, operation scope, and scope version; reject absent and ambiguous exclusive rules deterministically; derive warnings from evidence and linked validation content rather than fixture names; and reconcile configured, forced, shadow-recommended, candidate, eligibility, applied, run, connection, epoch, decision, operation, release, and retained-classification facts before materialization.
notes: Changing only a catalog mapping changes derivation without changing source evidence.
No behavior is inferred from performance data.

requirements.title: Represent sets, relationships, families, and interaction proof explicitly
requirements.statement: The experiment-control planning contracts MUST represent primary expected behaviors, possible effective behaviors, non-behavior outcomes, and activation signatures as deterministic sets; classify equivalence from expected behavior plus activation signature; provide the closed authority_overlap, structural_constraint, supplies_work, changes_observed_state, feedback_loop, shared_outcome_only, and context_effect relationship taxonomy over explicit axis or behavior nodes; distinguish family axes, fixed axes, outer contexts, workload archetypes, primary metrics, and guardrails; and block future interaction measurement execution unless readiness metadata contains one reviewed passed version-matched actuation proof for every forced behavior-distinct axis and value.
notes: The canonical readiness catalog records no reviewed actuation proofs because none were established by this checkpoint.
Missing proof yields blocked_for_measurement while correctness compilation remains inspectable.

requirements.title: Separate outcome accounting and rebuild projections from immutable inputs
requirements.statement: The evidence contracts MUST keep effective-behavior aggregates distinct from inactive, fallback, clamped, invalid, negative, error, unclassifiable, diagnostic, and terminal-release outcome aggregates; account for every operation exactly once within each applicable aggregate kind; preserve target-aware retained classifications; and rebuild the analytical projection deterministically from explicitly supplied immutable plan, validation, manifest, run, host, binary, workload, evidence, materialization, metric, artifact, and classification documents with exact identity, hash, authority-chain, epoch, decision, operation, aggregate, artifact, and classification joins.
notes: A mutable database is not the evidence authority.
The builder contains no repository-specific fixed input paths.

requirements.title: Prove hardening deterministically and preserve the frozen boundary
requirements.statement: The repository MUST retain valid, warning, expected-invalid, catalog-authority, ambiguity, filename-independence, reconciliation, release-order, classification, outcome, interaction-proof, set-expansion, and projection fixtures; validate the evolved schemas and canonical catalogs; reproduce materializations and projections byte-for-byte with stable hashes; reject invalid projection inputs with closed errors; preserve all v1 regressions; pass focused builds, requirement-home tests, and SpecTrace validation; and stop without runtime mechanism changes, another axis migration, performance work, campaign execution, CI changes, push, active_internal, or production activation.
notes: All performance and activation authorization fields remain false.
This is the mandatory stopping point for the bounded hardening checkpoint.

requirements.title: Derive operation outcomes and release ordering from canonical authorities
requirements.statement: The evidence-integrity closeout MUST resolve every non-behavior operation result to exactly one version-pinned effective-behavior-catalog outcome definition; derive the outcome ID and retained-classification requirement from that definition; reject zero and multiple matches with closed errors; resolve every owner release to exactly one complete operation identity and linked decision; compare the copied decision epoch to the linked decision's actual epoch; require the release epoch to exist and not precede decision or owner creation; and require exactly one terminal release when the mechanism contract requires it.
notes: The catalog remains an offline dependency and is not loaded on a runtime path.
Retained v1 behavior remains governed by its original contract.

requirements.title: Use exact classification targets and composite operation accounting
requirements.statement: The evidence-integrity closeout MUST version and validate a composite operation identity containing run, connection, epoch, axis, decision, and operation components; use that identity for decision joins, release joins, behavior and outcome derivation, aggregate sources, accounting, classification targets, and projection joins; require every classification to resolve exactly one target; preserve classification identity through materialization and projection; publish one versioned canonical classification compatibility matrix; reject every unpermitted pair with classification_contradiction; require exactly one primary retained outcome classification where the matched catalog outcome requires it; and prohibit supplemental classifications from satisfying that primary requirement.
notes: Numeric operation IDs and epoch sequences are never sufficient target identities in v3.
Old target IDs are not silently reinterpreted.

requirements.title: Validate and recompute the complete immutable projection authority chain
requirements.statement: The projection closeout MUST accept the fifteen explicit immutable plan, validation, manifest, run, host, binary, workload instance, requested workload, effective workload, operation evidence, behavior materialization, outcome materialization, metric, artifact inventory, and classification documents; validate every input against its exact schema and content hash; prove all required cross-document identities and references; require the artifact inventory to hash every peer immutable input; independently recompute behavior and outcome materializations from evidence and the exact catalog; reject any canonical mismatch; validate aggregate source composite identities; and emit an authority chain containing exact references to all fifteen inputs without fixed fixture paths, implicit discovery, placeholder identities, or mutable database authority.
notes: The artifact inventory lists the fourteen peer inputs and is itself referenced by the projection, avoiding impossible self-reference.
Projection inputs remain immutable files and not mutable database rows.

requirements.title: Prove evidence-integrity closeout and preserve the frozen boundary
requirements.statement: The repository MUST retain deterministic positive and expected-invalid fixtures for every catalog outcome, ambiguous and missing derivation, forged release ordering, exact and ambiguous classification targets, exhaustive classification pairs, composite-ID collision, aggregate recomputation, all fifteen projection inputs, unrelated self-hashed inputs, and repeated projection rebuilding; preserve and rerun the foundation, compiler and manifest, runtime-evidence, and hardening regressions; validate additive schemas and direct SpecTrace artifacts; pass focused Release builds and requirement-home tests; and stop without runtime mechanism changes, another axis migration, interaction execution, performance work, campaigns, transforms, threshold or model derivation, CI changes, push, active_internal, or production activation.
notes: The unrelated repository-wide SpecTrace baseline remains preserved and separately reported.
This is the mandatory stopping point for the evidence-integrity closeout.

requirements.title: Represent independent actuation proof as an external-review candidate
requirements.statement: The experiment-control system MUST represent each actuation-proof candidate as an immutable, versioned, content-hashed document scoped to exactly one axis and one behavior-distinct value; reference the exact plan, validation, manifest, run, operation evidence, behavior materialization, outcome materialization, projection, source commit, binary cohort, host, positive operation, fallback operation, shadow-neutrality evidence, rollback evidence, terminal release where applicable, and correctness assertions; keep active behavior and performance acceptance unauthorized; and require review_status candidate without self-issuing a reviewed or passed outcome.
notes: Candidate proof documents do not satisfy reviewed_actuation_proofs in the canonical experiment-family catalog.
The catalog promotion patch remains unapplied pending external review.

requirements.title: Prove single-eligible batch actuation independently
requirements.statement: The correctness-only batch actuation proof candidate MUST use an actuation-validation plan with application_send_batch_formation as the only varied axis and every adjacent axis fixed to legacy_current; prove that a forced single_eligible value becomes the pre-safety candidate, remains operation-eligible, is applied after more than one legal write exists, shortens the legal prefix to exactly one without widening or reordering it, preserves priority, same-stream sequence, completion ownership, and packet-plan commit or abandonment; retain a one-write inactive case, an authoritative fallback or clamp, a non-actuating shadow recommendation, and a rollback to the exact legal legacy prefix; and derive the intended effective behavior only from the emitted packet-plan mechanism event.
notes: The proof is correctness-only and makes no throughput, latency, CPU, or allocation claim.
Fixture expectations are not runtime truth.

requirements.title: Prove memory-conservative buffer actuation independently
requirements.statement: The correctness-only buffer actuation proof candidate MUST use an actuation-validation plan with buffer_copy_coalescing as the only varied axis and every adjacent axis fixed to legacy_current; prove that a forced memory_conservative value becomes the pre-safety candidate, remains operation-eligible, is applied after more than two legal source segments exist, lowers the exact legal prefix to two without widening or reordering it, rents the combined owner only after the decision, carries the complete decision and operation identity through the owner token, records exactly one terminal release, preserves cancellation, disposal, fallback, and ownership safety, retains an inactive or no-owner case, proves a non-actuating shadow recommendation, and rolls back to the exact legacy prefix; and derive the intended effective behavior only from the emitted combined-owner mechanism event.
notes: Release resolution uses the complete operation identity before accepting a linked decision.
The proof is correctness-only and does not execute a multi-axis cell.

requirements.title: Bridge focused mechanism evidence into the immutable authority chain
requirements.statement: A reusable offline correctness-evidence bridge MUST consume actual bounded batch or buffer mechanism evidence emitted by the runtime or focused mechanism harness; reject missing, duplicate, stale, contradictory, wrong-run, wrong-connection, and wrong-mechanism evidence; preserve exact decision, operation, release, epoch, run, connection, source, binary, and host identities; assemble the plan, validation, manifest, run, host, binary, workload, operation-evidence v3, behavior-materialization v3, outcome-materialization v2, correctness metrics, artifact inventory, exact classifications, and projection v3 inputs; recompute both materializations and the projection; and produce byte- and hash-identical output for deterministic inputs without runtime catalog loading or hot-path evidence structures.
notes: Workload shape is offline context and never a runtime controller input.
The immutable file chain remains authoritative; no mutable database is introduced.

requirements.title: Reject false actuation proofs and preserve the frozen boundary
requirements.statement: The independent proof validator MUST reject an unreached activation predicate, ineligible or safely replaced candidate claimed as positive actuation, shadow-driven actuation, wrong mechanism event, missing decision or operation correlation, missing or duplicate required buffer release, stale catalog, manifest, source, or binary identity, wrong run or connection, structurally inactive operation claimed as positive actuation, performance metric used as proof, reviewed or passed self-classification, and more than one behavior-distinct forced axis before runtime execution; retain valid fallback, inactive, negative, diagnostic, and rollback evidence; rerun prior experiment-control regressions and focused builds; and stop without interaction execution, performance work, another axis migration, CI change, push, active_internal, or production activation.
notes: All proof candidates remain external-review pending.
Measurement and active behavior remain unauthorized.

requirements.title: Independently review and promote the two approved actuation proofs
requirements.statement: The send-composition correctness milestone MUST independently rebuild and validate the exact immutable plan, validation, manifest, run, host, binary, workload, mechanism evidence, behavior materialization, outcome materialization, metric, artifact, classification, and projection inputs for application_send_batch_formation=single_eligible and buffer_copy_coalescing=memory_conservative; derive every review assertion from content rather than candidate claims or fixture names; reject stale or unverifiable source and binary identity; preserve the original candidate artifacts; emit a separate content-hashed review result; and add reviewed passed metadata only for an exact axis/value proof whose activation, safety fallback, shadow neutrality, rollback, ownership, release, catalog derivation, and frozen-boundary assertions all pass.
notes: Candidate records remain immutable and are not rewritten as passed records.
Promotion is limited to the two exact behavior-distinct send-composition values.

requirements.title: Authorize only the reviewed correctness-only send-composition cell
requirements.statement: The experiment-control compiler, compiled manifest, and internal runtime configuration MUST deny multi-axis behavior-distinct forcing by default; permit exactly application_send_batch_formation=single_eligible plus buffer_copy_coalescing=memory_conservative only when an interaction_screen plan references the reviewed send_composition family, both exact passed proof records, current contract, catalog, relationship, and constraint versions, a correctness_only execution purpose, false active and performance authorization, every outside axis fixed to legacy_current, a capability-permitted exact cell, and a runtime snapshot equal to that manifest cell; and reject candidate, missing, stale, wrong-value, wrong-family, unsupported, third-axis, production, performance, and manifest-mismatch authorization before mechanism execution.
notes: The capability is internal, typed, fixed-field, and unavailable through ordinary production configuration.
No general production adaptive controller or runtime catalog lookup is introduced.

requirements.title: Execute the approved two-axis interaction through production mechanism seams
requirements.statement: A bounded deterministic correctness harness MUST execute the approved exact two-axis manifest cell through the production batch-selection, buffer-coalescing, operation-evidence, owner-token, and terminal-release seams; retain independently attributable both-distinct-across-the-cell, batch-distinct-buffer-inactive, batch-inactive-buffer-distinct, both-inactive, authoritative fallback, shadow-neutrality, and rollback cases; preserve legal prefix order and lower-only authority; account for every operation with complete composite identity; and require every rented combined owner to have exactly one non-preceding terminal release without collecting or comparing performance measurements.
notes: Because single_eligible supplies one selected write, same-operation buffer distinctness is structurally impossible when that batch value actuates; the both-distinct cell proof therefore requires separate attributable opportunities in the same authorized cell.
Workload labels and host identity remain offline evidence context and never controller inputs.

requirements.title: Materialize and project the complete interaction evidence chain
requirements.statement: The interaction evidence bridge MUST consume bounded runtime-derived mechanism capture for the exact authorized cell; preserve plan, validation, manifest, runtime snapshot, proof prerequisites, run, host, binary, workload, decision, operation, release, epoch, catalog, and classification identities; deterministically derive behavior and outcome materializations from their canonical catalogs; recompute exact aggregates and all immutable joins; emit the complete fifteen-input analytical projection plus interaction-proof evidence; support multiple effective behaviors in one epoch; reject missing, duplicate, stale, contradictory, substituted, or performance-derived evidence; and reproduce canonical bytes and hashes for deterministic inputs except explicitly identified host or build identities.
notes: The immutable file chain remains authoritative and no mutable database is introduced.
Correctness counts, bytes, identities, and outcomes are evidence, not performance conclusions.

requirements.title: Independently review and adversarially audit interaction proof
requirements.statement: A separate interaction reviewer MUST ignore the proof document's claimed result and independently recompute plan and manifest authorization, reviewed proof prerequisites, runtime cell equality, candidate and applied values, activation predicates, mechanism events, behavior and outcome materializations, composite operation accounting, classification compatibility, owner release identity, rollback, immutable input joins, projection bytes, and hashes; issue passed only when every required condition is derived; and deterministically reject unreviewed or wrong proofs, stale catalogs, contracts, manifests, runtime mismatches, outside or third axes, unsupported combinations, active or performance authorization, identity and release forgeries, aggregate mismatches, projection substitutions, performance metrics, and stale rollback state.
notes: Review warnings and errors are content-derived and use closed codes.
An internally correctable failure is fixed and the evidence is regenerated before closeout.

requirements.title: Close the correctness milestone without releasing measurement
requirements.statement: The final send-composition correctness branch MUST preserve existing v1, v2, and v3 regressions; pass foundation, compiler, manifest, runtime-evidence, hardening, evidence-integrity, independent-proof, multi-axis authorization, interaction execution, interaction review, mechanism, ownership, focused Release build, direct SpecTrace, and diff checks; retain unrelated repository-wide SpecTrace failures; produce a content-complete review package and exact committed Git archive with SHA-256; leave the worktree clean; and stop without performance measurement, another-axis migration, production activation, active_internal, CI modification, or push.
notes: The only permitted readiness assessment is correctness_ready_measurement_still_frozen, not a measurement release.
No performance conclusion follows from this milestone.
